title: Fundamental Skills in Diagnostic Medical Sonography

program.section_heading: Certificate of Completion: Fundamental Skills in Diagnostic Medical Sonography
outcomes: Students will be able to develop competency in Diagnostic Medical Sonography by demonstrating core knowledge, technical, analytical, communication skills, and diagnostic proficiency, while upholding essential professional values of confidentiality and privacy, with an emphasis on patient care, critical thinking, ethics, professionalism, lifelong learning, and employability skills.

notes: Noncredit certificate, but the catalog's requirements list counts it in units ('Units Required: 0', each course 0.0), so measure is 'units' and total_units is the printed 0. No total hours are printed for the program.
The course description for NC.DMS-100 states 8.00 – 12.00 hours; no hours are printed for NC.HLTH-011 in this section. A reviewer may prefer to record the award in hours.
Catalog codes NC.DMS-100 and NC.HLTH-011 match closed-list NC.DMS 100 and NC.HLTH 11.
The text following this section (Diné Language and Culture for the Workplace) belongs to a different program and was ignored.

Careers are taken from the program description ('entry into Diagnostic Medical Sonography and other health professions'); 'a career in medical imaging' appears only in the course description and was not recorded.
